messages:
ash: Quick heads-up — we've seen 3 low-volume OOMs in prod-runtime this week, same boxpool, similar backtrace. Opening this thread to track follow-ups from the postmortem and assign remediation work. :warning:

mira: Ack. I sketched a timeline in the postmortem doc but want to make owners explicit. Main hypothesis: KV compaction path leaking page refs during concurrent access, plus compaction triggering a temporary allocation spike.

devon: I reproduced locally with a scaled-down workload. Heap shows 'drift' after repeated compactions; flamegraph points at "kv::compact_range" and a helper that pins small buffers. Link: https://grafana.internal/r/FLAME/abcd1234

james: Can we add a short-term mitigation (limit compaction concurrency + soft mem cap) while we debug? That should reduce the spike surface.

anya: +1 on mitigation. I can wire a dynamic limit behind a feature flag tonight. Who owns the rollout?

ash: @anya please own the temporary limit rollout (feature-flagged). Target: dark launch by EOD tomorrow, canary for 1% of traffic after basic smoke. Add rollback plan.

mira: I'll take ownership of deeper profiling and root cause writeup. Plan: full heap profiles across warmup/steady/compaction phases, heap histogram diffs, and a custom GC trace to see precise object lifetimes. ETA: 5 working days for initial RCA.

devon: I'll do the instrumentation changes to emit compact start/finish + per-shard live-set sizes. Also collect `gcore` samples on repro runs. PR: https://git.internal/r/CR/9876

sre-bot: New ticket created: INF-3127 "prod-runtime: recurring OOM pattern — KV compaction correlation" assigned to mira, devon, anya. Priority: P1. Link: https://tickets/internal/INF-3127

james: Short-term checklist (owner / due):
- Anya: feature flag mem cap + rollout plan / due 24h
- Devon: instrumentation + smoke repro harness / due 48h
- Mira: profiling plan + data collection schedule / due 5d
- Ash: coordinate on capacity bump if needed / due 24h

devon: Example commands I'm running for profiles:
```
# start a light repro with heap sampling
./run_repro --qps 50 --duration 30m --trace compact --heap-profiler=on
# collect flamegraph
scripts/collect_flame.sh --out /tmp/flame.svg
```

anya: Will also add a temporary alert threshold to stop compactions if free memory < 12% on a host. That should prevent the final spike.

ash: Couple of recurring-pattern checks we should track across incidents: compaction frequency, average free pages before compaction, per-shard live-set variance. Add these to incident telemetry so postmortems can compare apples-to-apples.

mira: Agree. I'll add metrics: `kv.compact.count`, `kv.compact.duration`, `kv.live_pages.mean`, `kv.live_pages.p95`. We'll backfill last 90 days.

james: For the RCA writeup, include regression window checks (recent kernel updates, jemalloc versions, or changes in compaction heuristics). We saw a small allocator tweak last month.

devon: Note: repro uses a smaller compaction interval by design, so absolute timing may differ. We'll include normalized graphs (compactions/hour vs mem-delta).

ash: OK — next sync: daily standup thread updates here until INF-3127 is closed. Please add short status lines (what's done, blockers). I'll consolidate for the weekly ops review. :eyes:

anya: Status (in-thread update): feature flag branch opened, basic unit tests pass. Still working on rollout playbook. ETA to canary: 18h.

devon: Status: instrumentation PR opened, waiting for review from @mira, added test harness logs to CI. Blocker: need permission to run longer repro on staging cluster (quota).

mira: Status: profiling plan posted to the incident doc, starting data collection tonight.

ash: Filing an action item: schedule cross-team demo of findings after initial RCA (owners: mira + devon). Target date: 2025-01-17.

james: If we see the leak tied to a specific compaction codepath we should prepare a patch and a canary deploy within 3 business days after RCA.

ash: Thanks all. Please keep updates concise here. If anything urgent pops up, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
